highlights: ByteRover CLI (brv) gives AI coding agents persistent, structured memory.
It lets developers curate project knowledge into a context tree, sync it to the cloud, and share it across tools and teammates.
The agent understands your codebase through an agentic map, can read and write files, execute code, and store knowledge for future sessions.
🧠 Context tree and knowledge storage management
🛠️ 24 built-in agent tools (code exec, file ops, knowledge search, memory management)
👀 Review workflow for curate operations (approve/reject pending changes)
📦 Hub and connectors ecosystem for skills and bundles
